name: HYP-1
ref: cf180da (main, build run 62 = 1.5.29: firmware.yml numbers runs from 33 as 1.5.0)
intro: A hypnotic techno and acid groovebox: pad, drone, a generative 303 line, noise and drums. It plays from power-on, so start by changing things, not by building from scratch.

rows.what: Walk through all the pages in order.
Change the four values at the bottom of the screen.
Tempo page: tempo, Evolve, Motion, Drift.
Pad. Tap again: Pad env, Pad LFO, Chords.
Drone. Tap again: Drone env, Drone LFO.
Acid. Tap again: Acid env, Acid line.
Drums. Tap again: Links, Kit, Drum drift.
Global: root, theme, tune, MIDI out.
Start or stop. It already plays after power-on.
Set the tempo (70-190) from any page.
Breakdown on the next bar. Again: four-bar build, then the drop.
During a breakdown or build: drop on the next bar.
Next chord, on the next bar.
Freeze: the chord holds until you tap REC again.
Add or remove that note from the scale (the root stays).
Pick the mode: Ionian, Dorian, Phrygian and more.
The page's voice an octave up; elsewhere the whole song. OCT- down.
On a voice's pages: play it by hand on the keys. Again: back.
Next sound of the voice on screen; on drum pages, the whole kit.
Evolve: more restless acid and chords. KNOB 3: Motion.
Drone filter cutoff (KNOB 4 sets resonance).
Acid cutoff (KNOB 3 resonance, KNOB 4 env mod).
Pad brightness (KNOB 3 picks one of 16 sounds).
Links on/off: kicks open the drone, snares flash the pad.
Links page: how hard each drum drives a voice.
Open the step sequencer: six drums, sixteen steps.
In the sequencer: turn that step of the drum on or off.
In the sequencer: next drum (kick, snare, clap, hats, perc). OCT- back.
In the sequencer: the drum's level, tune and decay.
Play pattern 1-6, from the next bar.
In the sequencer: copy this pattern to pattern 1-6.
In the sequencer: clear this drum. SEL + OCT+ restores it.
Swing (KNOB 2: drive, KNOB 4: pattern).
In the sequencer: back to the Drums page.
Effects menu on/off: each key is an effect while held.
FX: reverse, tape stop.
FX: mute kick, hats, snare, drone, acid, pad.
FX: low-pass, high-pass, closing in.
FX: gate 1/16, gate 1/8, echo throw, crush, drum fill.
FX: solo kick, hats, snare, drone, acid, pad.
Lock that effect on (black keys too); it outlasts the menu.
Switch to piece 01-10 now.
While playing: switch piece on the next bar.
Store this piece: settings, scale, sounds and patterns.
After 1.5 seconds: this piece back to factory.
After 5 seconds: update mode. Let go early to cancel.
Calibrate the buttons and knobs.
In SAFE MODE: try starting HYP-1 normally again.

keys.label: Scale notes; sequencer (hold SEQ): steps 1-16; SEL: patterns 1-6; FX: repeats, mutes, filters
Scale notes; FX: gates, throw, crush, fill, solos

tips: Quick beat of your own: hold SEQ, tap white keys to edit the kick, OCT+ for the next drum.
Noise and Space (echo, reverb) have no button: reach them with SELECT.
Changes stay while it's on, but only GLO then SAVE keeps them past power-off.
Power-on starts a random piece. No sound? Check MASTER and KNOB 1 (each voice's level).
Hold a button for a second on its own: a card explains it (not PLAY, SEL, SAVE, SEQ, FX).
MIDI out: pad ch 1, drone ch 3, acid ch 4, drums ch 10, plus clock. MIDI clock in drives the tempo.
checked: Clone of github.com/RustyPawz/fm1-HYP1 at cf180da (HEAD); GitHub Actions run 62 built that sha, and firmware.yml maps run N>=33 to 1.5.(N-33) = 1.5.29; the site and installer both show 1.5.29.
Labels: firmware/src/app/panel.c B_NAME/E_NAME, plat.h B_* enum; keys: ui.c WHITE_KEY/BLACK_KEY (index 0 = F3).
Pages and knobs: ui.c VIEW_NAME, VIEW_KNOB, KNOB_LABEL; GROUP[] (HOME 1, ENV 4, LFO 3, ARP 3, SEQ 4, GLO 1 pages); Noise/Space only on SELECT.
Buttons: ui.c button() (FX menu, EDIT next chord, PLAY, REC freeze, OCT page voice/song or lane in sequencer, SAVE breakdown/build/drop).

input(): SEL+ENV by hand (voice_of), SEL+SEQ links, SEL+OCT in sequencer shift_lane, SEQ held 400 ms = sequencer, SEQ tap in sequencer = Drums, HOME+SELECT tempo, SEL+ALGORITHM shift_sound, ALGORITHM set_mode, PRESETS set_piece / SEL+PRESETS on next bar while playing, Global SAVE store / 1.5 s factory, SAVE held 500 ms drop.
Keys: input() step_toggle in V_SEQ, by_hand en_note, else toggle_note (root stays); shift_key white 1-6 pattern, black 1-6 copy in sequencer.
FX map: ui.c KEY_FX/FX_LABEL; lock mode (SAVE held in FX), locks outlive the menu.
Store: project.c project_piece_save/pending; autosave() only writes pending stores and globals.
Recovery: main_fm1.c OCT-+OCT+ 5 s update mode with cancel, panel_setup at power-on, safe_main PLAY restart.
MIDI: dsp/amb.c midi(0x90/0x92/0x93/0x99) channels 1/3/4/10, 0xF8 clock; ui.c midi_in() clock in, ch 1 notes toggle scale.
Help cards: ui.c help_tick() excludes PLAY, SEL, FX, SAVE, SEQ.
Plays at start: ui.c ui_init/ui_frame en_play(1) after the splash.
unsure: Manual says 'SAVE held: the drop', but in code holding SAVE in the normal groove triggers a breakdown (button(B_SAVE)); it only drops during a breakdown/build. The sheet follows the code.
Manual and README are written for 1.5.0; Drum drift (SEQ 4th page) is newer and only partly checked, so it has no row.
ui.c header comment says SEQ cycles Drums then Links only; the GROUP table has four pages (Drums, Links, Kit, Drum drift). Sheet follows GROUP.
No MIDI & sync section: GLO KNOB 4 MIDI out and SEL+GLO remote are verified, but too few rows; kept as a tip.
Calibration check reads raw bits (buttons & 3) at power-on; assumed OCT-/OCT+ per the comment and panel.c.
